contract_rates_method_refs.name: contract_rates_method_refs
contract_rates_method_refs.value:
case "contract_rates"."method"
        when 'per_km_vehicle_type' then "contract_rates"."vehicle_type_id" is not null
        when 'specific_vehicle' then "contract_rates"."vehicle_id" is not null and "contract_rates"."route_id" is not null
        when 'route_fixed' then "contract_rates"."route_id" is not null
        when 'car_transport' then "contract_rates"."route_id" is not null
        when 'per_quantity' then "contract_rates"."unit" is not null
      end

sales_invoice_lines_refs.name: sales_invoice_lines_refs
sales_invoice_lines_refs.value:
case "sales_invoice_lines"."kind"
        when 'waybill' then "sales_invoice_lines"."waybill_id" is not null and "sales_invoice_lines"."waybill_expense_id" is null
        when 'expense' then "sales_invoice_lines"."waybill_expense_id" is not null
      end

vehicle_assignments_odometer.name: vehicle_assignments_odometer
vehicle_assignments_odometer.value: "vehicle_assignments"."odometer_end" is null or "vehicle_assignments"."odometer_start" is null or "vehicle_assignments"."odometer_end" >= "vehicle_assignments"."odometer_start"

waybills_execution_refs.name: waybills_execution_refs
waybills_execution_refs.value:
case "waybills"."execution"
        when 'fleet' then "waybills"."vehicle_id" is not null and "waybills"."driver_id" is not null and "waybills"."carrier_id" is null
        when 'carrier' then "waybills"."carrier_id" is not null and "waybills"."vehicle_id" is null and "waybills"."driver_id" is null
      end

waybills_odometer.name: waybills_odometer
waybills_odometer.value: "waybills"."odometer_end" is null or "waybills"."odometer_start" is null or "waybills"."odometer_end" >= "waybills"."odometer_start"
